sections.title: PI SpeedLAB - CEO & Technical Lead
bullets: **Employment**: 2025.10.22 - present (U.S. entity PI SpeedLAB, INC.).
**Responsibilities**: Led overall planning, design, and development of PI-Link; managed app, firmware, certification, manufacturing, and overseas business.
**App development**: Native camera module built directly in Kotlin (Android) and Swift (iOS) with BLE tuning - beta in operation (500 downloads), full launch planned.
**Key results**: First production run of 600 units and FCC/KC/CE/TELEC radio certification support.
**Key results**: Kickstarter funding success - 511 backers, $80,340 (goal $2,000).

**Key results**: 2026 Gyeonggi RISE / Kyung Hee AE Lab joint research - 210 kbps effective iOS BLE throughput and data rate optimization from 240 kbps to 110 kbps; 8 dB noise floor improvement and detection range extended from 2 m to 5 m; miss rate below 1% (from 7%) and false-detection rate below 1% (from 6%) across 1,000 pitches.
**Key results**: CES 2025/2026 and SPOEX 2025 exhibitions; NDA signed with radar specialist UNIDEN and licensing production negotiations.

sections.title: CaiqueTech - Development Co-representative
bullets: **Employment**: 2024.05.22 - 2025.01.01 (joined on contract, later co-representative).
**Founding**: Co-founded in 2024 - established the PI SpeedLAB brand and groundwork for the U.S. entity.
**Responsibilities**: Developed hardware, app, and firmware for the PI-Link USB-C connected 24 GHz modular radar; designed real-time speed display, logging, video capture, and day-by-day analytics.
**Design**: Combined Doppler radar module with smartphone-side compute for a lighter, more affordable speed gun than legacy devices.
**Verification**: Python-based Doppler analysis (power spectrum, spectrogram, CFAR) and an HIL closed-loop environment linking PCB, smartphone, PC, and J-Link.
**Key results**: 2 registered KR patents (10-2674614, 10-2861127) secured and a modular connection layer robust to sensor and PCB revision changes.
**Joint research**: Kyung Hee University AE Lab (advisor: Prof. Sang-hyuk Kim) - CFAR parameter tuning with staged root-cause isolation and iterative verification.

sections.title: Development Skill Set
sections.subtitle: Hardware + Mobile + Productization
bullets: **Sensor fusion design**: detachable Doppler radar module integrated with smartphone camera workflow.
**Mobile integration design**: USB-C connected hardware and app experience architecture.
**Data features**: speed measurement, history logging, video-linked records, and trend analysis.
**Product engineering**: prototype development, demo deployment, certification planning (KC/FCC), manufacturing readiness.
**Business execution**: MOU partnerships, international exhibitions, and crowdfunding go-to-market strategy.

**Tech stack**: Kotlin (Android) and Swift (iOS) native camera modules, Dart app development (since 2024), Python (6 years), Shell Script, STM32F373 MCU firmware (20 kHz signal acquisition via DMA/Ring Buffer), BLE (Renesas DA14531).
**Compression/transmission**: Delta lossless and ADPCM lossy compression implementations; BLE notification and 509-byte chunked transmission optimization.

**Joint research with Kyung Hee University AE Lab** (advisor: Prof. Sang-hyuk Kim) - CFAR parameter tuning and staged root-cause isolation from circuit to signal processing with iterative verification.
